gui.akaishi.upgrade.speed.hint: §7Install into a machine speed upgrade slot: +12.5%% processing speed per level (max 8, capped at +100%%)
gui.akaishi.upgrade.energy.hint: §7Install into a machine energy upgrade slot: +50%% energy capacity per level (max 8, capped at +400%%)
gui.akaishi.upgrade.stack_hint: §7Stacked in a single slot; stack size is the level
jei.akaishi.speed_upgrade: Installed into the 10 upgrade slots of the Akaishi Generator (single, Assembly or Super Architecture), one per slot. Each boosts output speed x1.75 but cuts yield by 1%%, up to 10 (max ~x242).
gui.akaishi.super_generator.formed_hint: Complete: 200x burn speed, total fuel energy x3 of a single generator
jei.akaishi.life_purifier: Solidifies Life Energy into a solid form. Feed Chi Energy (up to 1M/t) and Life Energy; each operation consumes 10M Chi + 1000 Life Energy to produce 1 Life Essence Solid. The output slot works with hoppers, AE2 and Item Pipes.
jei.akaishi.life_essence_solid: Obtained from the Life Energy Purifier: each operation consumes 10M Chi Energy + 1000 Life Energy to produce 1. A basic Life-research material and the solid input for cultivators, surgery tables, energy processors and more.
jei.akaishi.sample_collector: A portable life-energy vessel. Right-click a creature to extract its life sample (weaker creatures are easier: ≤50% HP +10%, ≤25% +10% more, capped 95%; max 3 successful extracts per creature); right-click life blocks/pipes to recharge. Purity leans low: 60% 0-49, 25% 50-74, 15% 75-100.
jei.akaishi.life_sample: Genetic material drawn from a living creature, carrying purity and source. Purity ≥25 feeds the Gene Analyzer; lower purity goes to the Potion Table. Purity drives the whole chain: sequence → organ integrity → rejection.
jei.akaishi.gene_sequence: The product of deconstructing a purity ≥25 sample. Keeps the sample's purity. The Life Structure Table builds organs from it: integrity = purity − random loss (0-20); 100→III, 50-99→II, <50→I.
jei.akaishi.potion: Bio-potion carrying a Permanent/Breakthrough template, inheriting the sample's source and purity. Permanent absorbs that creature's gene (+2~+10 compatibility to all organs of the source by purity, max 4); Breakthrough needs the gene absorbed and a grafted same-source organ, then activates 30 min: base stats +10%~40% and extra compatibility +2~+8 (negative-base traits suppressed), max 1 active. Failed prerequisites never consume the potion.
jei.akaishi.organ: An organ to implant (one per body slot). Quality and integrity set its power; rejection = quality × creature group × integrity modifier. Rejection grows over time (doubled below adaptation 60, ×1.6 for End/Dragon). Enemy pairs max it out and explode back.
jei.akaishi.gene_analyzer: Deconstructs purity ≥25 samples into gene sequences: 5,000 life energy, 5 seconds. Success scales with purity (70% at 25, 95% at 100); failure loses the sample.
jei.akaishi.cultivator: Strengthens samples and organs. Purify: +10 purity per run in four tiers (90/80/70/60% success, 1/2/4/8 solids and 10/20/40/80K energy). Upgrade: quality I→IV (85/75/65%; failure keeps the organ).
jei.akaishi.life_struct: Builds organs from gene sequences: 1 sequence + 5 solids + 80,000 life energy, 6 seconds. Integrity = purity − random loss (0-20), setting quality tier and adaptation.
jei.akaishi.surgery: Organ implant chamber. Implant: 3 solids + 20,000 energy, 4 seconds (target slot free and organ must match); Extract: 1 solid + 5,000 energy, organ returns to inventory.
jei.akaishi.potion_table: Brews potions: purity ≥25 sample + solids + life energy → Permanent/Breakthrough potion. Cost depends on the template; product inherits source and purity.
jei.akaishi.sample_vault: Large sample warehouse (54 slots): accepts samples only, identical ones auto-merge, supports pipes. Place within 3 blocks of an Analyzer/Potion Table to link access.
jei.akaishi.organ_vault: Body-slot paged organ freezer (9 pages × 9 slots + 9 buffer): organs auto-sort into their slot's page; drains 1 life energy/tick to stay active. Place near a Surgery Chamber etc. to link access.
jei.akaishi.potion_cabinet: Large potion warehouse (54 slots): potions only, auto-merge by template and purity, template filter and pipes supported. Place within 3 blocks of a Potion Table to link access.
jei.akaishi.reactor_controller: The Reactor Controller is the heart of the multiblock reactor. Build a closed box (side 5 or 7, 1-block thick walls) from Reactor Shells, put the Controller and ports on the walls, and 1 Core, Fuel Rods (≤10) and Coolers (≤20) inside. Feed Fuel Cells into the fuel slots; output peaks at 400-700℃. Above 850℃ it enters an overheat warning with reduced output (no shutdown); at 1000℃ full heat it explodes after 10 seconds, spawning a 5-chunk decay zone (decay debuff / wasteland / mutation). Breaking the reactor or its structure at full heat leaks a decay zone too.
jei.akaishi.reactor_shell: Reactor Shell: wall material of the multiblock reactor. Build a closed box of side 5 or 7 with all six faces complete for the structure to form.
jei.akaishi.reactor_fuel_rod: Fuel Rod: place inside the reactor; each unlocks one fuel slot (max 10). Only Coolers adjacent to a Fuel Rod count.
jei.akaishi.reactor_cooler: Cooler: place inside the reactor, right-click to insert a Heat Sink. Effective only when adjacent to a Fuel Rod; burns 1 sink durability per tick while active.
jei.akaishi.reactor_core: Reactor Core: the burning heart of the reactor. The interior must contain exactly one, or the structure won't form.
jei.akaishi.reactor_fuel_port: Fuel Port: place on the reactor wall. Has a 27-slot buffer that auto-feeds Fuel Cells to the controller and returns empty ones.
jei.akaishi.reactor_energy_output: Energy Output: place on the reactor wall. Generator-only output (5B buffer); energy pipes can extract but cannot charge it back. Right-click to view stored energy.
jei.akaishi.reactor_waste_port: Waste Port: place on the reactor wall. Export-only - pushes exhausted fuel into waste pipes (Sealed Exhausted Pipe / Multi-Fluid Waste Pipe); normal fluid pipes cannot connect.
jei.akaishi.exhausted_barrel: Exhausted Barrel: 1,000,000 mb tank for exhausted fuels (all 7 kinds can be mixed). Only waste pipes can insert/extract; shows a liquid level gauge. Breaking it triggers a decay zone scaled to its contents.
jei.akaishi.exhausted_pipe: Sealed Exhausted Pipe: waste-only fluid pipe carrying exhausted fuel only. Its network is physically isolated from normal fluid pipes (adjacent pipes of different families do not connect). Single buffer (8,000 mb) holding one exhausted fuel type at a time. Connects to Waste Ports and Exhausted Barrels. Breaking it triggers a decay zone scaled to its contents (tier 1-3).
jei.akaishi.multi_fluid_waste_pipe: Multi-Fluid Waste Pipe: waste-only fluid pipe carrying exhausted fuel only. Its network is physically isolated from normal fluid pipes. Multi buffer (8,000 mb) allowing all 7 exhausted fuels to mix in transit. Connects to Waste Ports and Exhausted Barrels. Breaking it triggers a decay zone scaled to its contents (tier 1-3).
jei.akaishi.heat_sink: Heat Sink: effective when installed in a Cooler adjacent to a Fuel Rod. Poor 1%/36k ticks, Normal 2%/72k, Good 3%/108k, Fine 4%/144k, Exquisite 5%/180k, Ultimate 7%/180k; loses 1 durability per burning tick and shatters at zero (unrepairable).
jei.akaishi.end_mixture: End Mixture: crafted from Ender Eye + Shulker Shell + Chorus Fruit. Liquefied into End Mixture Fuel (utilization 4, 600k/t per slot).
jei.akaishi.dragon_mixture: Dragon Mixture: crafted from Dragon's Breath + End Crystal + Obsidian. Liquefied into Dragon Fuel (utilization 7, 1.05M/t per slot).
jei.akaishi.sculk_lifeform: World Base Fuel: crafted from Golden Carrot + Sculk Block + Golden Apple + Akaishi Essence Block. Liquefied into World Base Fuel (utilization 3, 450k/t per slot, heat value 120).
jei.akaishi.fuel_cell: Fuel Cell: filled with liquid fuel by the Fuel Canner, 10 L (10,000 mb) capacity, not stackable once filled. Place in a reactor fuel slot to burn.
jei.akaishi.energy_liquefier: Energy Liquefier: liquefies Nether Stars, Wither Roses and the three mixtures into liquid energies and fuels (some recipes need Life Essence Solids).
jei.akaishi.energy_processor: Energy Processor: refines pure/compound liquid energy into Pure Fuel and Nether Compound Fuel for advanced mixing.
jei.akaishi.fuel_canner: Fuel Canner: fills Fuel Cells with liquid fuel (10,000 mb each) for reactors and other machines.
jei.akaishi.fuel_mixer: Fuel Mixer: blends fuels: End Mixture + Nether Compound → Advanced Mixture (utilization 5); Dragon + Pure → Ultimate Mixture (utilization 10, 1.5M/t per slot).
jei.akaishi.item_pipe_basic: Logistics relay: transports items across a pipe network to connected containers/machines. Basic: 1 item/tick. Use the Akaishi Configurator to toggle Push/Pull modes or disconnect a side.
jei.akaishi.item_pipe_advanced: Logistics relay: transports items across a pipe network to connected containers/machines. Intermediate: 4 items/tick.
jei.akaishi.item_pipe_elite: Logistics relay: transports items across a pipe network to connected containers/machines. Advanced: 16 items/tick.
jei.akaishi.item_pipe_ultimate: Logistics relay: transports items across a pipe network to connected containers/machines. Ultimate: 64 items/tick for mass transfer.
jei.akaishi.catalyst_basic: Consumes Akaishi Energy to grow crystal clusters on Geodes in range. Range 3x3x3, 20% chance, 5 E/t.
jei.akaishi.catalyst_medium: Consumes Akaishi Energy to grow crystal clusters on Geodes in range. Range 5x5x5, 30% chance, 25 E/t.
jei.akaishi.catalyst_advanced: Consumes Akaishi Energy to grow crystal clusters on Geodes in range. Range 9x9x9, 40% chance, 125 E/t.
jei.akaishi.catalyst_ultimate: Consumes Akaishi Energy to grow crystal clusters on Geodes in range. Range 16x16x16, 50% chance, 625 E/t.
jei.akaishi.collector_basic: Auto-harvests clusters, storing essence in a 27-slot container. Range 3x3x3, 30 ticks/cluster, 2 E/t. Works with hoppers, AE2 & Mekanism pipes.
jei.akaishi.collector_medium: Auto-harvests clusters, storing essence in a 27-slot container. Range 5x5x5, 15 ticks/cluster, 4 E/t. Works with hoppers, AE2 & Mekanism pipes.
jei.akaishi.collector_advanced: Auto-harvests clusters, storing essence in a 27-slot container. Range 9x9x9, 7 ticks/cluster, 8 E/t. Works with hoppers, AE2 & Mekanism pipes.
jei.akaishi.collector_ultimate: Auto-harvests clusters, storing essence in a 27-slot container. Range 16x16x16, 2 ticks/cluster, 16 E/t. Works with hoppers, AE2 & Mekanism pipes.

akaishi.patchouli.akaishi_diary.name: Akaishi Research Diary
akaishi.patchouli.akaishi_diary.landing_: Welcome to the Akaishi Research Diary. From your first crystal dug out of an ore cluster to the supreme power that drives reactors and fusion cores, this book will walk you through the entire journey.$(br2)$(bold)New here?$(0) Start with "Akaishi Journey Overview", the first entry of the "Getting Started" chapter — it tells you what to do first and what comes next.$(br)Chapters progress in order: Intro → Energy → Machines → Miner → Advanced → Tech. The little circles beside each entry track your research progress; follow them in order to unlock the full path.

akaishi.patchouli.life_secrets.name: Secrets of Life
akaishi.patchouli.life_secrets.landing_t: Above Akaishi Energy lies a higher form of power — Life Energy.$(br2)Begin with "The Path of Life Research", the first entry of the "Life Energy Intro" chapter, to grasp the main line: Energy → Samples → Genes → Organs → Enhancement, then dive into each chapter.$(br)Every page of this book points you to the next step of research.$(br2)$(bold)Note:$(0) The life branch depends on the Akaishi Energy system — finish the Intro and Energy chapters of the Akaishi Research Diary first.
gui.akaishi.activator.hint: No slots: waste in & activated liquid out via pipes
jei.akaishi.life_activator: Life Activator: consumes Life Energy (100 per mb) to slowly neutralize exhausted fuel into its activated form 1:1 (e.g. Activated Exhausted Nether Compound Fuel). Waste pipes connect to the input (Waste) tank; normal fluid pipes extract the safe activated liquid from the output tank for long-term storage. Breaking it while exhausted fuel remains in the input tank leaks a decay zone (tier 1-3 by volume).
jei.akaishi.activated_crystal: Obtained: separate the matching activated exhausted fluid in a Life Centrifuge (every 1000mb yields that activated crystal ×1 + Exhausted Crystal ×1); activated exhausted fluid is made by neutralizing exhausted fuel in the Life Activator.
jei.akaishi.activated_component: Obtained: split the matching activated crystal in an Activated Fractionator (1 crystal → activated component ×1 + Exhausted Crystal ×1). Components feed advanced fuel machines such as the Fusion Fuel Aggregator.
jei.akaishi.exhausted_crystal: Obtained: common by-product of the Life Centrifuge and Activated Fractionator. Used as a cost material for the Item Reconstructor, Life Breeder and Trait Reforger.
jei.akaishi.life_ash: Obtained: by-product produced while the Fusion Reactor burns plasma rods (taken out via the item output port); Life Ash is only produced by the Fusion Reactor and cannot be crafted in a crafting table.
jei.akaishi.life_fusion_ingot: Obtained: build the Mother Goddess Altar ritual structure (central altar + 8 inner-circle altars), offer the heart and organs of compatibility 50 or higher as required; the ritual triggers automatically, consumes every offering and drops 1 Life Fusion Ingot. See the Book of Life for the ritual details.
jei.akaishi.fusion_fuel_aggregator: Fusion Fuel Aggregator: uses Akaishi energy to fuse activated components into scorching plasma. Sculk/Advanced Mixture/Ultimate Mixture components produce Mixed Plasma; Nether Compound/Pure produce Nether Plasma; End Mixture/Dragon produce End Plasma. Output can only be extracted by Plasma Pipes.
jei.akaishi.plasma_filler: Plasma Filler: injects plasma into a Fusion Rod (1 rod + 1000 mb matching plasma -> 1 plasma rod). Plasma rods are the fuel carrier for the future fusion reactor.
jei.akaishi.plasma_pipe: Plasma Pipe: the third transport family; transfers plasma only, physically isolated from normal fluid and waste pipes.
jei.akaishi.plasma_tank: Plasma Fuel Tank: stores plasma only (16,000 mB); pipe-accessible for Plasma Pipes only, non-plasma fluids cannot be filled.
jei.akaishi.fusion_rod: Fusion Rod: crafted from a Akaishi Ingot and Life Essence Solids; the fuel carrier used by the Plasma Filler.
jei.akaishi.plasma_rod: Plasma Rod: a Fusion Rod charged with plasma by the Plasma Filler, awaiting the fusion reactor.
gui.akaishi.fusion.item_input_hint: Insert fusion fuel rods (empty rods are not returned)
jei.akaishi.fusion_reactor: Fusion Reactor: an onion-style 7x7x7 multiblock (shell -> insulation -> frames -> core). Burning fuel rods produces Akaishi Energy and Life Ash; efficiency frames boost yield and heat (x1.15^N); cooler frames unlock heat sink slots in the controller (up to 10). Place heat sinks into the controller via its Heat GUI page to offset heat. Optimal yield at 100M~130M; at 160M it shuts down (no explosion), recovers at 80M, heat sinks keep draining while cooling.

jei.akaishi.wireless: Wireless Akaishi Energy: build a closed 5x5x5 box of Terminal Shells with the Terminal, Controller and Security Block on the walls and exactly 1 Wireless Terminal Core in the center of the cavity. Input/Output Ports do NOT sit on the walls: authorize an identity card at the terminal's Security page, then right-click a port with the same card to bind it, and the port links to the terminal wirelessly through the card (inspired by MEK quantum links). The Terminal auto-binds formed Akaishi Energy Cell Serializers within 1 block as the network storage hub. Place a Terminal Dimension Bridge inside the cavity to unlock cross-dimension transfer (fixed loss), a Chunk Loading Frame to soft-load the network chunks so the network keeps running when you are away, and a Chunk Loading Range Module to expand the soft-load area to 3x3 chunks around the terminal and every port. Input/Output Loss Suppressors reduce the transfer loss of the corresponding direction (5%% each, stackable, capped at 90%%). Distance raises transfer loss (capped at 50%%); wireless transfer is uncapped — the identity card is pure authentication, with no rate cap, and cannot be upgraded.
